name: Neural Feature Fusion Fields (N3F)
aliases: Neural Distillation of Self-Supervised 2D Image Representations
definition: A method that distills dense 2D image features (from a self-supervised or supervised teacher network) into a 3D representation (student network) defined in world space, using differentiable neural rendering to fuse features across multiple views.
summary: Neural Feature Fusion Fields distills continuous 2D image features into a 3D neural field via volumetric rendering, enabling open-world applications without manual labels.
